nodes.name: Nature of godhood (ascension)
nodes.summary: In PoE lore a mortal of rare quality could ascend to godhood on the adoration of their people, shedding mortality; this became impossible once Sin created the Beast. Becoming a god often costs one's humanity. Gods can also be 'made' by belief of followers (Innocence's ascension was fuelled by hatred of Sin).

chronology.relative: before the creation of the Beast

sources.locator: Sin, 'The Origins of the Gods': "There was a time before the Beast ... men and women like you could ascend. Through rareness of quality and the adoration of their people..."

nodes.name: The Pantheon (soul-capture mechanic)
nodes.summary: Game mechanic and lore device by which Sin captures the essences of slain gods and grants the Exile a fraction of their powers. Major gods: Brine King, Arakaali, Solaris, Lunaris. Minor gods: Tukohama, Abberath, Ryslatha (Act 6), Gruthkul, Ralakesh (Act 7), Yugul (Act 8), Garukhan, Shakari (Act 9).

sources.locator: section 'The Pantheon'; Sin dialogue 'The Father of War': "While a god may fall, their essence lingers... That essence can be yours"

nodes.name: Slumbering of the Gods
nodes.summary: Sin's Beast lulled the gods into dreamless slumber, ending an era of divine strife; Hinekora foresaw it and prepared the Halls of the Dead before sleeping.

chronology.relative: unknown, millennia before PoE1 (before the Vaal Empire per PoE2 wiki)

sources.locator: Sin 'The Rise of the Gods': "We gods, we were driven into slumbering darkness, to dream away eternity whilst the gentle Beast watched over us."
Hinekora dream: 'She foresaw the Slumbering of the Gods' / hinekora wiki Lore

nodes.name: Sin creates the Beast
nodes.summary: Sin planted the Dark Ember/Seed of Corruption beneath Highgate and nurtured it into the Beast to suppress the gods and end mortal ascension. PoE2 wiki adds that Sin sought Kalandra's cryptic advice and found the Seed in a Precursor ruin.

sources.locator: paragraph 2: Sin ... sought the ancient being Kalandra ... found a Precursor ruin containing the Seed of Corruption

nodes.name: Awakening of the gods
nodes.summary: Killing the Beast in Act 4 woke the dormant gods (Kitava, Tukohama, Abberath, Ryslatha, Brine King, Gruthkul, Arakaali, Garukhan, Shakari, Solaris, Lunaris...), setting up PoE1 Part 2.

sources.locator: last paragraph: 'Following the actions of the player in Act 4 ... the old Gods (such as Kitava) are awakened'

nodes.name: Original Sin (Innocence's ascension)
nodes.summary: Per Lycia's relics, twin brothers Innocence and Sin lived among the Azmeri; Innocence, unable to attract enough followers, turned his followers against Sin and used their hatred to ascend, leaving Sin blackened. The Templar stained-glass version is propaganda.

sources.locator: section on Forbidden Sanctum relics / Lycia's findings; 'Original Sin' unique
[24:43]-[25:12] Lycia's story of Sin and Innocence among the Azmeri

nodes.name: Winter of the World
nodes.summary: Ancient war in which Kulemak and the Lightless blanketed the Vastiri Plains and the surface, ended when the Three Sisters (Solerai/Lundara etc.) destroyed Kulemak's mortal form and brought back the sun.

sources.locator: paragraph 1: 'Winter of the World ... lasted for centuries'

nodes.name: Gods as belief and Beast-energy
nodes.summary: Interpretive concept: gods in Wraeclast are sustained by worship and by proximity to the Beast's power; their abilities are 'restricted by the Beast'. Fan synthesis built from wiki statements on godhood and the Beast.

sources.locator: Lore: 'Like the other gods of Wraeclast, Kitava's abilities are restricted by the Beast'
Halani found powerless from lack of worship (see PoE1 'God' page, Maraketh gods)

nodes.name: The Beast
nodes.summary: Divine creature, source of thaumaturgy and corruption, grown by Sin from the Dark Ember beneath Highgate to keep the gods asleep. Has no will of its own; exploited by Doryani, Atziri, Chitus, Malachai. The Exile kills it in Act 4; PoE2 follows a new Beast grown from the stolen Seed of Corruption.

nodes.name: Dark Ember
nodes.summary: Seed from which the Beast grew; its residue after the Beast's death is extracted by the Exile and Sin from the Beast's core using the souls of Shavronne, Maligaro and Doedre, and used against Kitava.

sources.locator: dialogue 'The Dark Ember' / 'Shavronne': "The very seed that brought my Beast into existence. The Dark Ember."

nodes.name: Seed of Corruption
nodes.summary: Essence found by Sin in a Precursor ruin and used to create the Beast; in PoE2 a seed is stolen by Count Geonor from Sin and grows into a new Beast.

nodes.name: Sin
nodes.summary: God, twin brother of Innocence, 'Thief of Virtue', creator of the Beast and Exile's ally in PoE1 Act 5-10 (sources the Pantheon); husband of Garukhan, father of Shakari. In PoE2 he hides as the Hooded One.

sources.locator: Lore: reveals himself as Sin at the end of Act 2

nodes.name: Innocence
nodes.summary: Templar god of light and purity, twin of Sin; per Lycia's relics his ascension was fuelled by turning followers against Sin. In Act 5 High Templar Avarius is his vessel; after Sin's 'more sensible host' (Bannon) sacrifices himself with the Staff of Purity in Act 10, he is reborn, helps defeat Kitava and then goes into self-exile in the far south.

sources.locator: Avarius as vessel of Innocence (see Kitava page: Triumph of Innocence)
quest An End to Hunger/Death and Rebirth: Bannon resurrects Innocence

nodes.name: The Forgotten Daughter
nodes.summary: Unique monster in Act 2 Fellshrine Ruins representing Sin and Innocence's sister, from before the gods; presumably never ascended.

nodes.name: Sign of Purity
nodes.summary: Weapon forged by Innocence from his own blood, kept in the Templar Ossuary; destroyed by Kitava's beam in Act 5.

sources.locator: Act 5: beam destroys the Sign of Purity

nodes.name: Kitava
nodes.summary: Karui god of chaos, hunger and corruption (Father of Corruption, the Cannibal King, Black Spirit); invited into Wraeclast by the Eternals per Karui lore, devours Oriath and is slain by the Exile with Sin and Innocence in Act 10.

nodes.name: Hinekora
nodes.summary: Karui Mother of Death; collects souls in the Halls of the Dead, foresees events across timelines, whipped Kitava into the underworld with her hair, and slept after foreseeing the Slumbering of the Gods. Oversees the Trial of the Ancestors.

nodes.name: Tukohama
nodes.summary: Karui god of war; his tooth slashed Kitava's face. Revived by the Beast's death, he raises the Karui Fortress and is the first god the Exile captures for the Pantheon in Act 6. Kaom claimed to be his son (carvings in Kaom's Stronghold).

nodes.name: Valako
nodes.summary: Karui god of storms and lightning; his jaw became a fish hook, one of Kitava's Torments.

sources.locator: Lani: 'A fish hook that was once the Valako's Jaw'

nodes.name: Ngamahu
nodes.summary: Karui goddess of fire, Mother of Fire; honoured in Ngamakanui.

sources.locator: Halls of the Dead test; Karui tattoos by god's domain

nodes.name: Tasalio
nodes.summary: Karui god of water, Father of Water.

nodes.name: Tawhoa
nodes.summary: Karui god of the forest and birds, Father of the Forest.

nodes.name: Ramako
nodes.summary: Karui god of light and the sun; husband of Sione; fathered Arohongui in an alleged affair with Lani Lua, which he claims was an impostor.

nodes.name: Rongokurai
nodes.summary: Karui god of the night; accused of helping Ramako's affair; on bad terms with Ramako.

nodes.name: Lani Lua
nodes.summary: Karui Mother of the Moon (the Karui sister name for the lunar goddess), involved in the myth of Ramako and Arohongui. Note: The Three Sisters page lists Lani Lua as sun and Sione as moon, contradicting the God page (Lani Lua moon, Sione sun); the wiki is inconsistent.

sources.locator: Karui: Lani Lua (sun), Sione (moon) - wiki lists them in this order; conflicts with Karui Gods page

nodes.name: Sione
nodes.summary: Karui Mother of the Sun, wife of Ramako, locked in endless battle with Lani Lua. See Lani Lua node for wiki inconsistency on which is sun/moon.

nodes.name: Arohongui
nodes.summary: Karui moon goddess, Daughter of the Moon; daughter of Ramako and Lani Lua in myth (possibly Tangmazu's child).

nodes.name: Kitava's Torments
nodes.summary: Three Karui relics taken by Templars: Hinekora's Hair (whip), Tukohama's Tooth, and Valako's Jaw (fish hook). Lani asks the Exile to recover them in Act 5 for the Karui defence of Ngamakanui. Optional quest (Act 5, 'required: no').

nodes.name: Kitava invited into Wraeclast
nodes.summary: Karui carvings say the Eternals opened the gate and invited Kitava into the land; Kitava cut the Karui off from the Ancestors. Haku adds that the Karui also had a hand in the downfall.

sources.locator: Weathered Carving in Kaom's Stronghold; Haku 'The Karui and Wraeclast'

nodes.name: Solaris
nodes.summary: Eternal/Azmeri sun goddess, twin sister of Lunaris; led a rival cult after Tangmazu tricked her into believing Lunaris betrayed her. Sin has her soul captured for the Pantheon in Act 8. (PoE2 appearance of Solaris/Lunaris by name not verified in the local PoE2 corpus; Maraketh variants Solerai/Lundara and the Three Sisters myth cover PoE2.)

nodes.name: Lunaris
nodes.summary: Eternal/Azmeri moon goddess, sister of Solaris; her rivalry was engineered by Tangmazu. (PoE2 appearance of Solaris/Lunaris by name not verified in the local PoE2 corpus; Maraketh variants Solerai/Lundara and the Three Sisters myth cover PoE2.)

nodes.name: Viridi
nodes.summary: Third sister of Solaris and Lunaris, Azmeri goddess of the earth, trapped within 'the orb' in Azmeri creation myth; probable namesake of the Viridian Wildwood.

nodes.name: The Three Sisters
nodes.summary: Cross-cultural myth of the sun, moon and earth sisters who destroyed Kulemak's mortal form and ended the Winter of the World; named differently by Eternals, Maraketh, Karui, Azmeri and the Wildwood Draiocht (Catha, Mhacha, Morrigan).

nodes.name: Tangmazu
nodes.summary: Trickster god (Raven Trickster / Tekaru / Black Crow), brother of Ralakesh, who caused the Solaris-Lunaris feud. The Strange Voice of Delirium mirrors; in PoE2 he is bound in Kedge Bay by Karui bindings, disguised as Freya Hartlin, and freed in Dark Mists.

sources.locator: Freya Hartlin reveals herself as Tangmazu

nodes.name: Ralakesh
nodes.summary: God of subjugation and control, Master of a Million Faces, brother of Tangmazu. Eramir says he ruled a Vaal city and enslaved Azmeri to repopulate it; the God page lists him among Azmerian/Eternal gods. His relic possessed Greust; in the Act 7 quest The Master of a Million Faces the Exile kills Greust and Sin then drains and kills Ralakesh.

sources.locator: intro + Lore (Eramir/Sin quotes); 'Sin will then kill Ralakesh by draining its power'

nodes.name: Arakaali
nodes.summary: Vaal harlot turned fertility goddess and queen, the Spinner of Shadows; held Sin captive; sealed in the Temple of Decay and slain by the Exile in Act 7.

nodes.name: Gruthkul
nodes.summary: Bestial minor god, Mother of Despair / Porcelain Queen, a mother whose children were slaughtered by Arakaali and whose grief made her a horned beast; Act 7 Pantheon boss. Sources disagree on the culprit: the God page says Arakaali slaughtered her children; Sin's dialogue says the Vaal laid waste to her kingdom; Sin's 'Mother of Despair' dialogue says her daughters plotted against Arakaali.

nodes.name: Ryslatha
nodes.summary: Former Azmeri matriarch who lost her children to Tukohama's warriors and became a parasitic carrion queen; Act 6 Pantheon boss.

nodes.name: The Brine King
nodes.summary: Azmeri king Tsoagoth turned god of storms and sea, worshipped by the Brinerot pirates with sacrifices; Act 6 Pantheon boss.

nodes.name: Abberath
nodes.summary: Former scholar who consumed souls of goats and became the goat-like Cloven One; father of the Faun; Act 6 Pantheon boss.

nodes.name: Yugul
nodes.summary: Vaal scholar obsessed with fear who used mirrors to petrify terror; ascended through worship; slain by the Exile in Act 8 (Reflection of Terror).

nodes.name: Garukhan
nodes.summary: Maraketh storm goddess, Queen of the Winds; wife of Sin, mother of Shakari; formerly the hero Orbala, Sekhema of Sekhemas (PoE2). Slain by the Exile in Act 9 at Sin's request.

nodes.name: Shakari
nodes.summary: Daughter of Sin and Garukhan; Queen of the Sands, twisted scorpion-like by lust for power; optional Act 9 boss.

nodes.name: Orbala
nodes.summary: Maraketh warrior who fought the 'bandit king of Stridevolf'; PoE2 states she was the mortal identity of Garukhan before ascension, known as the Sekhema of Sekhemas. PoE1 3.22 relics (a traveller freeing Sin from Innocence's worshippers) are suggested, not confirmed, to be her.

nodes.name: Halani
nodes.summary: Forgotten Maraketh water goddess, found powerless and dying from lack of worship in PoE2 Act 2 Buried Shrines; mother of Azarian.

nodes.name: Prospero
nodes.summary: Azmerian god of wealth and the underworld, patron of the Perandus family; Cadiro struck a deal for long life.

nodes.name: Kamasa
nodes.summary: Vaal Monkey God of wealth and greed; mentioned in PoE2 Act 2/3 and in PoE1 items.

sources.locator: Orb of Sacrifice named for Kamasa

nodes.name: Kopec
nodes.summary: Vaal god, presumably of sun or fire; PoE2 has the Temple of Kopec.

nodes.name: Yaomac
nodes.summary: Vaal shepherd of souls with three serpentine heads who maintains the balance of seasons.

nodes.name: The First Ones
nodes.summary: Group of animalistic Ezomyte gods including Craiceann, Farrul, Fenumus, Saqawal, the Greatwolf and the Gull; roam the realm of Spirit.

nodes.name: Chaos
nodes.summary: Impulse able to see across timelines, once worshipped by Vaal priests; master of the Trialmaster and enemy-of-sorts to Hinekora's fixed prophecies.

nodes.name: Order
nodes.summary: Impulse opposed to Chaos; almost nothing is known.

nodes.name: Kulemak
nodes.summary: Master of the Lightless and creator of the Lich Lords; exalted within the Well of Souls (which arose after The Master Below All 'raged'), he waged the Winter of the World against the surface until the Three Sisters destroyed his mortal form; his soul returned to the Well. Namesake of the Horns of Kulemak (Immortal Syndicate). PoE2 pinnacle of the Well of Souls content.

nodes.name: The Master Below All
nodes.summary: Ancient being whose rage created the Well of Souls, power source of necromancy; nothing else known.

nodes.name: The Well of Souls
nodes.summary: Source of necromantic power that collects all souls; hub area in PoE2 Abyss content.

nodes.name: Amanamu
nodes.summary: Amanamu is an Abyssal Lich and one of Kulemak's three most powerful servants commanding the Lightless.

nodes.name: Kurgal
nodes.summary: Kurgal is an Abyssal Lich and one of Kulemak's three most powerful servants commanding the Lightless.

nodes.name: Ulaman
nodes.summary: Ulaman is an Abyssal Lich and one of Kulemak's three most powerful servants commanding the Lightless.

nodes.name: The Bodach
nodes.summary: Embodiment of the Unlight sealed away by the Three Sisters in Wildwood Azmeri myth; PoE2 Ritual pinnacle boss in Caer Tarth, tied to the King in the Mists (0.5).

sources.locator: paragraph 3: Sisters sealed away the Bodach

nodes.name: The Molten One
nodes.summary: Last known Titan from a prehistoric era, indirectly worshipped as the volcano home of the Redblade warband.

nodes.name: Kalandra
nodes.summary: Ancient owl-bodied being trapped in her lake since the primordial era; disdains gods ('thieves of virtue') and is said to have counselled Sin on creating the Beast.

nodes.name: Vaal Oversoul
nodes.summary: Colossal Vaal entity summoned on the Dark Altar in the Ancient Pyramid with The Apex; Act 2 final boss. Wiki gives no explicit lore on its nature; its relation to Vaal soul-worship is inferred.

sources.locator: intro; map variant 'Vessel of the Vaal'

nodes.name: Brinerot
nodes.summary: Pirates who worship the Brine King and drown mutineers or slaves.

nodes.name: Azarian, the Forsaken Son
nodes.summary: Son of Halani, abandoned and raised among the Faridun; Act 2 boss in Buried Shrines.

nodes.name: The Spirit
nodes.summary: Mysterious entity with which Yeena (Act 2) communicates; listed among Azmerian/Eternal gods on the God page. Nothing more is stated.

nodes.name: The Goddess of Justice
nodes.summary: Deity worshipped by Izaro Phrecius; known only by this title.

nodes.name: The God of Domination
nodes.summary: Mysterious, possibly otherworldly god tied to the Harbingers; Harbinger uniques foretell its gaze falling over Wraeclast.

nodes.name: Thruldana
nodes.summary: God whose name Undertaker Arimor invokes in a chant; nothing else is known.

nodes.name: Bannon
nodes.summary: Templar commander and Act 10 ally who uses the Staff of Purity to resurrect Innocence, sacrificing himself; Lani says he went to Hinekora's home. Minimal node (owned by campaign domain).

sources.locator: quest Death and Rebirth: Bannon used the Staff of Purity and sacrificed himself to resurrect Innocence
